leak.reader: LANDED THE CALL at Tibu, 137 action-days, 92.2 per 100,000, but at about 45 to 50 per cent confidence with Sardinata at 121.4 named as the main alternative, and it says in terms that the pack never says which way to go. Question 1 clean, nothing names the decisive step, and it found no single-use file. Three findings to fix, and the first is the one that matters most. (1) ANNOUNCEMENT: protocol 4.1 reads "Los registros del Observatorio son la evidencia de esa actividad y no su medida", which the reader calls an unusual sentence for a working protocol. It is the build's whole thesis stated in the pack, which is leak-check sweep 5, and it is the shape that cost task196 a reader landing. Cut or reduce it to a clause that does not name the distinction. The Boletin's two cautions ("su cobertura no es uniforme entre municipios" and "no compara municipios entre si ni anticipa la designacion") and the dictionary's "Ninguno de los dos entra en el registro", which does the analyst's decoy sorting for them, are the same class and want the same treatment. (2) UNIFORMITY, the rule firing on the device itself: the April step is in exactly the three cities, and their new outlets send 40 to 76 items per row in a tight band against 5 to 10 everywhere else, which the reader says looks built to a step-change pattern rather than like the organic variation in the other 20 municipalities. Give the new outlets the per-row spread the existing ones have. (3) A date inconsistency: the dictionary is dated 5 November 2026 and the extract described as taken that day, while 2026 fecha_registro runs only to 2026-10-19. AND THE ONE TO WEIGH AGAINST THE JUDGE: the reader reports that only about 12 of Sardinata's 177 semester action-days are cited solely by the new outlets, so 165 of 177 survive dropping them, and that the old outlets' own volume also tripled. Its conclusion is that the three cities may carry a genuine surge too and the pack cannot separate the two. If that holds it is a Gate C finding rather than a Gate F one, because the decisive step would not be forced by the records. HOLD the fix pass for the judge, which is still running, and fix both sets in one generator pass.
